newsitem.title: UK: UK Rail cos in pension windfall -- pressure group.
newsitem.headline: UK Rail cos in pension windfall -- pressure group.

text.p: Privatised rail companies in Britain will gain around 500 million stg from the government in the form of a surplus from the pension fund of British Rail, pressure group Save Our Railways said.
Each of the new railway operation companies that succeeded the once state-owned British Rail will receive a share of the surplus, the campaigners said.

"While we want to reassure railway pensioners that their pensions are safe, we are outraged to learn that the government is prepared to allow pension fund surpluses to be raided in order to line the pockets of privatised rail companies," said Jonathan Bray of Save Our Railways.
The pressure group will write to British Prime Minister John Major asking him to intervene to ensure the pension fund surplus is not diverted to the privatised rail companies.

British newspapers reported that, while the pensions of existing employees are safe, the 60 or so rail operating companies could use the surplus to take a pension holiday -- thereby reducing their payments into pension schemes.
No one from the private rail companies was available for comment.
